text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Dortmund sits at 9.7 €/m², up 2.4 % year‑on‑year and 23.2 % over the past five years. The inter‑quartile range spans 8.4 €/m² to 11.19 €/m², placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive German markets.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.1 % and an average of 33 days on market. Tenants face a rent burden of 14.4 % for a two‑person household, while 22 % of listings are let within a week. Asking rents are about 50 % higher than the 2022 existing‑rent level of 6.45 €/m².

The model‑based forecast predicts the median asking rent to reach 10.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.52 €/m² – a 6.2 % increase.
